name: Device Health Monitoring
description: Windows MDM settings in the Device Health Monitoring category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: [Deprecated] Config Device Health Monitoring Scope
properties.description: If the device is not opted-in to the DeviceHealthMonitoring service via the AllowDeviceHealthMonitoring then this policy has no meaning. For devices which are opted in, the value of this policy modifies which types of events are monitored.

properties.name: [Deprecated] Config Device Health Monitoring Service Instance
properties.description: If the device is not opted-in to the DeviceHealthMonitoring service via the AllowDeviceHealthMonitoring then this policy has no meaning. For devices which are opted in, the value of this policy modifies which service instance to which events are to be uploaded.

properties.name: [Deprecated] Config Device Health Monitoring Upload Destination
properties.description: If the device is not opted-in to the DeviceHealthMonitoring service via the AllowDeviceHealthMonitoring then this policy has no meaning. For devices which are opted in, the value of this policy modifies which destinations are in-scope for monitored events to be uploaded.

properties.name: Allow Device Health Monitoring
properties.description: Enable/disable 4Nines device health monitoring on devices.

properties.name: Config Device Health Monitoring Scope
properties.description: If the device is not opted-in to the DeviceHealthMonitoring service via the AllowDeviceHealthMonitoring then this policy has no meaning. For devices which are opted in, the value of this policy modifies which types of events are monitored.

properties.name: Config Device Health Monitoring Upload Destination
properties.description: If the device is not opted-in to the DeviceHealthMonitoring service via the AllowDeviceHealthMonitoring then this policy has no meaning. For devices which are opted in, the value of this policy modifies which destinations are in-scope for monitored events to be uploaded.
